prompt:
You are an autonomous agent operating inside the current working directory. BEFORE anything else, write out a numbered plan that covers every step listed below (no fewer than 8 steps). Use the planning/todo tool you have; if you have none, put the plan into plan.md. Then carry out the steps in order, writing every required file under the exact filename stated. Never invent content: every statement must be traceable to the fixture files shipped in this directory. Once every artifact exists and has been checked, wrap up with a brief completion summary.

Act as a literature scout for a titanium-alloy group. The file papers_db.jsonl in this directory holds 18 records. Build a map of the RECENT literature only: every paper published in 2022 or later.

Deliverables and required order (the plan must list at least 8 steps):
1. Produce your plan first.
2. Read papers_db.jsonl and select every record with year >= 2022; there are 11 of them and every one must appear in screening_log.md as: id, title, first author, year, DOI.
3. Write property_matrix.md: one row per selected paper with the alloy studied and whatever quantitative properties the record carries (UTS, elongation, temperatures...). Cells must quote the fixture verbatim; use 'n/a' when a record carries no value.
4. In gap_analysis.md, describe at least two points where the recent records disagree in trend or scope, quoting the record ids that clash.
5. Write recent_review.md (target 460 words or more) with the sections Trends, Methods landscape, Gaps, References.
6. Cite records inline as [Sxxx]; a marker may only be used if that id exists in papers_db.jsonl.
7. Write citation_index.md mapping each marker used to its full citation line.
8. Confirm all five files exist, then finish.
plan_steps: Record the screening decisions in screening_log.md
Build property_matrix.md from values actually present in the fixture
Hunt for contradicting trends between recent papers -> gap_analysis.md
Final existence check of all five artifacts
